title: 30-Minute Private Baseball Lesson in Long Beach & OC | MBM
description: A focused 30-minute 1-on-1 baseball lesson with Coach Myles — hitting, fielding, throwing, or baseball IQ. A quick tune-up between games. Long Beach & Orange County, ages 8–18.
lead: The 30-minute session is focused, 1-on-1 time built around a single priority. It's the quick tune-up — sharpen a swing, clean up footwork, or fix one thing before the weekend's games — without committing to a longer block.
body: Because the time is short, the work is deliberate. You and Coach Myles pick one focus — hitting, fielding, throwing, or baseball IQ — and spend the session drilling it with real reps and immediate feedback. It's ideal when your player has a specific thing to work on rather than a full-game overhaul.

Plenty of players use the 30-minute session as a regular tune-up between games or practices, dropping in to keep a mechanic sharp during the season. If your player wants to cover more ground in one visit, the 60-minute session gives room for multiple skills plus a video clip.
Want frame-by-frame detail on a swing or delivery? Add the Swing/Mechanics Video Breakdown — slow-motion video with coach feedback and a couple of focus drills to take home.
bestFor: Players with one specific skill or mechanic to sharpen
Families who want a shorter, lower-commitment session

faq.q: What can we cover in 30 minutes?
faq.a: One focus area — hitting, fielding, throwing, or baseball IQ — worked deliberately with real reps and feedback. For multiple skills in one visit, the 60-minute session fits better.

faq.q: Can I add a video breakdown?
faq.a: Yes. The Swing/Mechanics Video Breakdown add-on gives you slow-motion video with frame-by-frame feedback and 2–3 take-home drills.
Coach Myles travels to you across Long Beach and Orange County — a field or facility that works for your family.
